G0500.def:
άντι-χριατος, -ον, ό
Antichrist, "one who assuming the guise of Christ opposes Christ" (Westc., Epp. Jo., 70): 1Jo 2:18 Jn 2:22 Jn 4:3, 1Jo 1:7 pl. 1Jo 2:18 (cf. ψευδόχριστος, and see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0501.def:
ἀντλέω, -ῶ
(ἄντλος, bilge-water in a hold), [in LXX for שָׁאַב, etc. ;]
__1. prop., to bale out.
__2. Generally, to draw water: absol., Jo 2:8 4:15; ὕδωρ, Jo 2:9 4:7 (on its use of the water made wine, see DCG, ii, 815a; MM, VGT, see word; Field, Notes, 84 f.).†
(AS)

G0502.def:
ἄντλημα, -τος, τό
(ἀντλέω),
__(a) prop., what is drawn (Diosc.);
__(b) a vessel to draw with, a bucket (Plut.; see Abbott, Essays, 88): Jo 4:11.†
(AS)

G0503.def:
ἀντοφθαλμέω, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ὀφθαλμός), [in LXX: Wis.12:14 * ;]
to look in the face, look straight at (Polyb.). Metaphorical, to face, withstand (Wis, l.with, Polyb.): with dative, ἀ. τ. ἀνέμῳ, as nautical term, to beat up against the wind (see DB, ext., 366 f.; MM, VGT, see word): At 27:15.†
(AS)

G0504.def:
ἄνυδρος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ὕδωρ) [in LXX for צִיָּה, יְשִׁימוֹן (γῆ ἄ), etc. ;]
waterless: τόποι, Mt 12:43, Lc 11:24; πηγαί, 2Pe 2:17; νεφέλαι, Ju 12 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0505.def:
ἀν-υπόκριτος, -ον
(ά- neg., ὑποκρίνομαι) [in LXX: Wis.5:18 18:16 * ;]
unfeigned: Rm 12:9, 2Co 6:6, 1Tm 1:5, 2Tm 1:5, Tg 3:17, 1Pe 1:22 (Cremer, 380; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0506.def:
ἀνυπότακτος, -ον
(ά- neg., ὑποτάσσω) [in Sm.: 1Rs 2:12 10:27 (for LXX, λοιμός, בֵּן בְּלִיַּעַל)* ;]
of things, not subject to rule: Hb 2:8; of persons, unruly: 1Tm 1:9, Tt 1:6, 10 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0507.def:
ἄνω
adv (ἀνά),
__(a) up, upwards: Jo 11:41, Hb 12:15;
__(b) above (opposite to κάτω): Act_2:19; with art. ἡ, Gl 4:26, Fp 3:14; τά, Jo 8:23, Cl 3:1-2; ἕως ἄ. (up to the brim), Jo 2:7 (Cremer, 106; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0508.def:
ἀνάγαιον (Rec. ἀνώγεον; on the form, see Rutherford, NPhr., 357 f.; MM, VGT, see word), -ου, τό
(ἀνά, γῆ),
an upper room: Mc 14:15, Lc 22:12.†
SYN.: ὑπερῷον (AS)

G0509.def:
ἄνωθεν
adv (ἄνω),
__(a) from above: ἀπὸ ἄ., Mt 27:51, Mc 15:38; ἐκ τῶν ἄ., Jo 19:28; meaning, from heaven: Jo 3:31 19:11, Tg 1:17 3:15, 17 .
__(b) from the first, from the beginning: Lc 1:3, At 26:5; whence
__(with) anew, again: Jo 3:3, 7, (so most, but see Meyer, in l; cf. Field, Notes, 86 f.); πάλιν ἄ., Gl 4:9 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0511.def:
ἀνώτερος, α, -ον
[in LXX: Ne 3:25 (עֶלְיוֹן), Eze.41:7 (מַעַל), Tob.8:3 * ;]
only in neut., as adv. (cf. ἐξώτερος),
__(a) of motion, higher: Lc 14:10;
__(b) of rest, above, before: Hb 10:8.†
(AS)

G0512.def:
ἀν-ωφελής, -ές
(ἀ- neg., ὄφελος), [in LXX: Is 44:10 (יָעַל בִּלְתִּי) Jr 2:8 (יָעַל לֹא), Pv 28:3, Wis.1:11 * ;]
unprofitable: Tt 3:9; neut. as subst., unprofitableness: Hb 7:18.†
(AS)

G0513.def:
αξίνη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for גַּרְזֶן, קַרְדֹּם ;]
an axe: Mt 3:10, Lc 3:9.†
(AS)

G0514.def:
ἄξιος, -α, -ον
(ἄγω, in sense, to weigh), [in LXX for בֵּן (Dt 25:2), מָלֵא, שָׁוָה; frequently in Wis, 2Mac ;]
__1. Part One
__(a) of weight, worth (often with genitive, cf. Pr 315, 811), before πρός: Rm 8:18 (see Field, Notes, 157);
__(b) befitting, meet: with genitive, Mt 3:8, Lc 3:8 23:41, At 26:20, 1Co 16:4 (see M, Pr., 216); absol., 2Ts 1:3;
__(with) of persons, worthy;
__2. Part Two
__α in good sense: with genitive of thing(s), Mt 10:10, Lc 7:4 10:7, At 13:46, 1Tm 1:15 4:9 5:18 6:1; with aor. inf. (see M, Pr., 203): Lc 15:19, 21, Act_13:25, Ap 4:11 5:2, 4 5:9, 12; before ἵνα: Jo 1:27; ἅς, Lc 7:4; absol., but of what understood: Mt 10:11, 13 22:8, Ap 3:4; with genitive of person(s), Mt 10:37-38, Hb 11:38;
__β in bad sense; with genitive of thing(s), Lc 12:48 23:15, At 23:29 25:11, 25 26:31, Rm 1:32; absol., Ap 16:6 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0515.def:
ἀξιόω, -ῶ
(ἄξιος), [in LXX chiefly for בְּעָא, בָּקַשׁ; frequently in Wis.1:1-16, 2 Mac ;]
__(a) to deem worthy: with accusative and inf. (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. κατ-αξιόω), Lc 7:7; id. and genitive of thing(s), 2Ts 1:11; pass. with genitive of thing(s), 1Tm 5:17, Hb 3:3 10:29
__(b) to think fit: with inf. (see M, Pr., 205), At 15:38 28:22.†
(AS)

G0516.def:
ἀξίως,
adv. [in LXX: Wis.7:15 16:1, Sir.14:11 * ;]
worthily: Rm 16:2, Ef 4:1, Fp 1:27; with genitive (frequently in Inscr.; Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, 51), ἀ. τ. Κυρίου, Cl 1:10; τ. θεοῦ 1Ts 2:12, 3Jn.6.†
(AS)

G0517.def:
ἀόρατος, -ον
(ὁράω), [in LXX: Gn 1:2 (תֹּהוּ), Is 45:3 (מִסְתָּר), 2Ma.9:5 * ;]
unseen, invisible: Rm 1:20, Cl 1:15-16, 1Tm 1:17, Hb 11:27.†
(AS)

G0518.def:
ἀπ-αγγέλλω
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi. ;]
of a messenger, speaker, or writer, to report, announce, declare: with accusative of thing(s), At 4:23, al.; with dative of person(s), Mt 2:8, al.; before ὃτι, Lc 18:37; πῶς, Lc 8:36; περί, Lc 7:18 13:1, At 28:21, 1Ts 1:9; λέγων, At 22:26; with accusative and inf., At 12:14; before εἰς, Mc 5:14, Lc 8:34 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 25)
(AS)

G0519.def:
ἀπ-άγχω
(ἄγχω, to press, strangle), [in LXX: 2Rs 17:23 (חָנַק), Tob.3:10 * ;]
to strangle; mid., to hang oneself (or, to choke; see M, Pr., 155): Mt 27:5.†
(AS)

G0520.def:
ἀπ-άγω
[in LXX for נָהַג, הָלַךְ hi., etc. ;]
to lead away: Lc 13:15, At 23:17 24:7 (R, mg.), 1Co 12:2; esp. of leading to trial (so as law term in Attic), prison and death (MM, VGT, see word): Mt 26:57 27:2, 31, Mc 14:44, 53 15:16, Lc 21:12 22:66 23:26, At 12:19; of the direction of a way: Mt 7:13-14 (cf. συν-απ-άγω).†
(AS)

G0521.def:
ἀ-παίδευτος, -ον
(παιδεύω), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, etc., chiefly in Wis. lit. ;]
uninstructed, ignorant: 2Tm 2:23.†
(AS)

G0522.def:
ἀπ-αίρω
[in LXX chiefly for נָסַע ;]
to lift off, hence, to take away; pass.: Mt 9:15, Mc 2:20, Lc 5:35.†
(AS)

G0523.def:
ἀπ-αιτέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Dt 15:2-3, al. (נָגַשׂ), Sir.20:15, Wis.15:8, al. ;]
to ask back, demand back: Lc 6:30 12:20 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0524.def:
ἀπ-αλγέω, -ῶ
__1. prop., to cease to feel pain for (Thuc., ii, 61).
__2. In late Gk.
__(a) to despair (Polyb., i, 35, 5);
__(b) to become callous, reckless (Polyb., xvi, 12, 7; MM, VGT, see word): Ef 4:19.†
(AS)

G0525.def:
ἀπ-αλλάσσω
[in LXX for סוּר hi., etc. ;]
to remove, release: Hb 2:15; pass., to depart: At 19:12; in legal sense (MM, VGT, see word), before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), to be quit of: Lc 12:58 (Cremer, 90, 632).†
(AS)

G0526.def:
ἀπ-αλλοτριόω, -ῶ
[in LXX for זוּר, H5110 etc. ;]
to alienate, estrange; pass.: Ef 2:12 4:18, Cl 1:21 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 95, 633).†
(AS)

G0528.def:
ἀπαντάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for פָּגַע ;]
__1. to go to meet.
__2. to meet; with dative: Mc 14:13, Lc 17:12 (WH, mg., ὑπ-; in Rec. frequently as see1. for ὑπ-, which see).†
(AS)

G0529.def:
ἀπάντησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπαντάω), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
usually with seel., ὑπ-; a meeting; εἰς ἀ., with genitive or dative, to meet: Mt 25:6 27:32 (WH, txt., omits), At 28:15, 1Ts 4:17 (see M, Th., in l; M, Pr., 14, 242; MM, VGT, see word; Lft., Notes, 69).†
(AS)

G0530.def:
ἅπαξ
adv., [in LXX for אֶחָד, פַּעַם ;]
__(a) once: 2Co 11:25, Heb_9:26-27; ἔτι ἅ., Hb 12:26-27; ἅ. τ. ἐνιαυτοῦ, Hb 9:7; καί ἅ. κ. δίς, twice: Fp 4:16, 1Ts 2:18;
__(b) once for all: Hb 6:4 9:28 10:2, 1Pe 3:18, Ju 3 5 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0531.def:
ἀ-παρά-βατος, -ον
(παραβαίνω),
inviolable, and so unchangeable: Hb 7:24 (see Westc., in l; Cremer, 653; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0533.def:
ἀπ-αρνέομαι (-οῦμαι) depon.,
[in LXX: Is 31:7 (מָאַס) * ;]
to deny, i.e. to refuse to recognize, to ignore: with accusative, of oneself (DCG, ii, 598 f.), Mt 16:24, Mc 8:34 (MM, VGT, see word), Lc 9:23 (WH, mg., txt., ἀρν-) of Peter's denials of Christ, Mt 26:34-35, 75, Mc 14:30-31, 72, Lc 22:34, 61; pass., Lc 12:9 (Cremer, 111).†
(AS)

G0535.def:
ἀπαρτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀπαρτίζω, to finish),
completion: Lc 14:28 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0536.def:
ἀπ-αρχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀπάρχομαι, to make a beginning in sacrifice, offer first fruits) [in LXX chiefly for תְּרוּמָה, רֵאשִׁית ;]
__1. the beginning of a sacrifice.
__2. first fruits: τοῦ φυράματος (cf. Nm 15:20), Rm 11:16. Metaphorical, ἀ. τοῦ πνεύματος: Rm 8:23; of Christians: Rm 16:5, 1, 1Co 16:15, 2Ts 2:13 (WH, mg., R, mg., txt., ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς; see Lft., Notes, 119 f.), Tg 1:18, Ap 14:4; of Christ: 1Co 15:20 15:23 (Cremer, 117; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0537.def:
ἅπας, -ασα, -αν
(strengthened form of πᾶς, see: ἅ-),
all, the whole, altogether: bef. subst. with art., as Lc 3:21; or after, as Mc 16:15]; absol., in masc., as Lc 5:26; in neut., as At 2:44; ἅ. οὗτοι, At 2:7 (LT); ἅ. ὑμεῖς, Gl 3:28 (TTr.). Most frequently in Lk, Ac (see MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)

G0538.def:
ἀπατάω, -ῶ
(ἀπάτη), [in LXX for פָּתָה, נָשָׁא hi., etc. ;]
to deceive: with accusative, Tg 1:26; with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), Ef 5:6; pass., 1Tm 2:14 (on its infrequency in late writers, see MM, VGT, see word; cf. ἐξαπατάω).†
(AS)

G0539.def:
ἀπάτη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Ec 9:6 א (no Heb. equiv.), Jdth.9:3, 10 9:13 16:8, 4Ma.18:8 * ;]
deceit, deceitfulness: Cl 2:8; τοῦ πλούτου, Mt 13:22, Mc 4:19 (MM, VGT, see word); τῆς ἀδικίας, 2Ts 2:10; τῆς ἁμαρτίας, Hb 3:13; αἱ ἐπιθυμίαι τῆς ἀ., Ef 4:22. pl., ἀπά ται (see M, Th., i.e.; NTD, 75; MM, l.with): 2Pe 2:13 (WH, mg., R., txt., ἐν ἀγάπαις).†
(AS)

G0540.def:
ἀπάτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ὴ
(ἀ- neg., πατήρ)
__1. fatherless.
__2. without father (MM, VGT, see word), i.e., with no recorded genealogy: Hb 7:3.†
(AS)

G0541.def:
ἀπ-αύγασμα, -τος, τό
(αὐγή, brightness, whence ἀπαυγάζω, to radiate or reflect) [in LXX: Wis.7:26 * ;]
of light beaming from a luminous body, radiance, effulgence: Hb 1:3.†
(AS)

G0543.def:
ἀπείθεια
(WH, -θία, exc. Hb 11:1-40. with), -ας, ἡ (ἀπειθής), [in LXX 4Ma.8:9 4Mac 8:18 4Mac 12:4 * ;]
disobedience (MM, VGT, see word): Rm 11:30, 32, Hb 4:6, 11; υἱοὶ τῆς ἀ. (genitive of definition, see M, Pr., 73 f.), Ef 2:2 5:6, Cl 3:6 (T, WH R, mg., omit).†
(AS)

G0544.def:
ἀπειθέω, -ῶ
(ἀπειθής), [in LXX for מָרָה, סָרַר, etc. ;]
as in cl. (MM, VGT, see word); to disobey, be disobedient: absol., At 14:2 19:9, Rm 10:21 11:31 15:31, Hb 3:18 11:31, 1Pe 3:20; with dative, Jo 3:36, Rm 2:8 11:30, 1Pe 2:8 3:1 4:17 (Cremer, 475).†
(AS)

G0545.def:
ἀπειθής, -ές
(πείθομαι), [in LXX for מַרְאָה, מְרִיא, סָרַר ;]
disobedient: absol., Lc 1:17, Tt 1:16 3:3; with dative, At 26:19, Rm 1:30, 2Tm 3:2.†
(AS)

G0546.def:
ἀπειλέω, -ῶ (ἀπειλή)
[in LXX: Na 1:4 (גָּעַר), Is 66:14 (זָעַם), Sir.19:17, al. ;]
to threaten: 1Pe 2:23; mid., At 4:17 (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. προσαπειλέω).†
(AS)

G0547.def:
ἀπειλή, -ῆ, ἡ
[in LXX for גְּעָרָה, etc. ;]
threatening, threat: At 4:29 9:1, Ef 6:9.†
(AS)

G0548.def:
ἄπ-ειμι
(εἰμί, sum) [in LXX for כָּחַד ni., נָדַח ni. ;]
to be absent: 1Co 5:3, 2Co 10:1 10:11 13:2 13:10 Fp 1:27, Cl 2:5.†
(AS)

G0550.def:
ἀπ-εῖπον, 2 aor. without present in use
[in LXX for מָאַס, אָמַר, etc. ;]
__1. to tell out.
__2. to forbid (3Ki.11:2).
__3. to renounce: 1 aor. mid. (WH, App., 164; MM, VGT, see word), 2Co 4:2.†
(AS)

G0551.def:
απείραστος, -ον
(πειράζω for cl. ἀπείρητος, πειράω),
untempted, untried, without experience: Tg 1:13 (see Hort, in l; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0552.def:
ἄπειρος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., πεῖρα, trial), [in LXX: Nm 14:23, Zc 11:15 (אֱוִלִי) Jr 2:6 (עֲרָבָה) * ;]
without experience of: with genitive of thing(s), Hb 5:13 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0553.def:
ἀπ-εκ-δέχομαι depon.,
to await or expect eagerly (Lft., Notes, 149; MM, VGT, see word): absol., 1Pe 3:20; C. accusative of thing(s), Rm 8:19, 23 8:25, 1Co 1:7, Gl 5:5; with accusative of person(s), Fp 3:20, Hb 9:28.†
(AS)

G0554.def:
ἀπ-εκ-δύω
to strip off clothes or arms; mid., to strip off from oneself: Cl 3:9; to strip, despoil (mid, for act., ICC, in l; but cf. Lft., Ellic.), Cl 2:15.†
(AS)

G0555.def:
ἀπ-έκ-δυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπεκδύω)
a putting or stripping off: Cl 2:11 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0556.def:
ἀπ-ελαύνω
[in LXX for נָצַל, שָׁלַח ;]
to drive away: At 18:16 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0557.def:
ἀπ-ελεγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀπελέγχω, to convict, refute),
refutation, disrepute: ἐλθεῖν εἰς ἀ., At 19:27 (not elsewhere; see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0558.def:
ἀπ-ελεύθερος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
a freedman: τ. κυρίου (MM, see word), 1Co 7:22.†
(AS)

G0560.def:
ἀπ-ελπίζω
[in LXX: Is 29:19 (אֶבְיוֹן), Jdth.9:11, Et 4:17, Sir.22:21 27:21, 2Ma.9:18 * ;]
__1. to give up in despair, despair of (Polyb., Diod., LXX).
__2. to hope to receive from or in return (Field, Notes, 59; Cremer, 712; Soph., Lex., see word): with accusative (M; Pr., 65; MM, see word), Lc 6:35.†
(AS)

G0561.def:
ἀπ-έναντι
adv. with genitive (Hellenistic, common in LXX);
__1. over against (MM, see word): Mt 27:61, Mc 12:41, WH, mg.
__2. before, in the presence of: Mt 27:24 (WH, mg.), At 3:16, Rm 3:18.
__3. against: At 17:7.†
(AS)

G0562.def:
ἀπέραντος, -ον
(περαίνω, to complete, finish) [in LXX: Jó 36:26 (חֵקֶר אַיִן) 3Mac.20 * ;]
endless, interminable: 1Tm 1:4.†
(AS)

G0563.def:
ἀπεριστπάστως
adv. (περισπάω the adj. occurs in Wis.16:11 Sir.41:1);
without distraction: 1Co 7:35.†
(AS)

G0564.def:
ἀ-περί-τμητος, -ον
(περιτέμνω), [in LXX chiefly for עָרֵל ;]
uncir­cumcised; metaphorically (τ.) καρδίαις (cf. Jr 9:26, al.): At 7:51 (ἄσημος, found in π., appears to have been the word used by Greek-speaking Egyptians: see Deiss., BS, 153; cf. also Cremer, 885; MM, see word)†
(AS)

G0565.def:
ἀπέρχομαι,
[in LXX chiefly for הלךְ ;]
__1. to go away, depart (also, in late writers, with "perfective" force, to arrive at a destination, the thought being carried on to the goal; M, Pr., 111f., 247; MM, see word);
__(a) absol.: Mt 13:25, al.; ptcp., ἀπελθών, used pleonastically with other verbs as in Heb. (Dalman, Words, 21), Mt 13:28, al.;
__(b) with mention of place or person: εἰς, Mt 14:15; ἐπί, Lc 24:24; πρός, Ap 10:9; ἀπό, Lc 1:38; ἐξω, At 4:15; ἐκεῖ, Mt 2:22.
__2. As in LXX, before ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי), to go after, follow: Mc 1:20, Jo 12:19; metaphorically, Mc 1:42, Ap 21:1.
(AS)

G0568.def:
ἀπ-έχω
[in LXX chiefly for רָחַק ;]
__1. trans.,
__(a) to hold back, keep off;
__(b) to have in full, to have received (on the " punctiliar " force of the compound, see M, Pr., 109, 247): with accusative, Mt 6:2, 5 6:16, Lc 6:24, Fp 4:18, Phm 15 (for illustr. from π., where it is used in receipts, see Deiss., BS, 229; LAE, 110 f.; MM, see word); impers., ἀπέχει (Field, Notes, 39), it is enough: Mc 14:41.
__2. Intrans., to be away, distant: absol., Lc 15:20; before ἀπό, Mt 14:24 15:8, Mc 7:6, Lc 7:6 15:20 24:13. Mid., to abstain: with genitive, At 15:29, 1Tm 4:3, 1Pe 2:11; before ἀπό, At 15:20, 1Ts 4:3 5:22.†
(AS)

G0569.def:
ἀπιστέω, -ῶ
(ἄπιστος), [in LXX: Wis.1:2 10:7 12:17 18:13, Sir.1:27, 2Ma.8:13 * ;]
__1. to disbelieve, be faithless: Mc 16:11, 16, Lc 24:11, 41, At 28:24, 1Pe 2:7; so prob. also Rm 3:3, 2Tm 2:13 (ICC, CGT, in ll; MM, see word).
__2. = ἀπειθέω (Hdt.; on this sense in Ro, 2Ti, ll. with, see Vaughan on Ro, l.with; Lft., Notes, 265; Thayer, see word).†
(AS)

G0570.def:
ἀπιστία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄπιστος), [in LXX: Wis.14:25, 4Ma.12:4 * ;]
want of faith, unbelief: Mt 13:58, Mc 6:6 9:24 16:14, Rm 3:3 (but see: ἀπιστέω) Rm 4:20 11:20, 23, 1Tm 1:13, Hb 3:12, 19 (DCG, ii, 775a; Cremer, 492).†
(AS)

G0571.def:
ἄ-πιστος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., πιστός) [in LXX: Pv 17:6 28:25, Is 17:10 * ;]
__(a) of things, incredible: At 26:8;
__(b) of persons, without faith or trust, unbelieving: Mt 17:17, Mc 9:19, Lc 9:41 12:46, Jo 20:27, Tt 1:15, Ap 21:8; specif., of unbelievers as opposite to Christians: 1Co 6:6 7:12-15 10:27 14:22-24, 2Co 4:4 6:14-15, 1Tm 5:8 (cf. Lft., Notes, 265; Cremer, 491).†
(AS)

G0572.def:
ἀπλότης, -ητος, ή
(ἁπλοῦς), [in LXX: 4Ki.15:11 (תֹּם), 1Cr 29:17 (לֵבָב יֹשֶׁר, ἁ. τῆς καρδίας, cf. Cl 3:22, where see Lft.), Wis.1:1, al. ;]
simplicity, sincerity: Rm 12:8, 2Co 11:3, Ef 6:5, Cl 3:22; as manifested in generous, unselfish giving, liberality, graciousness: 2Co 8:2 9:11 9:13 (see ICC, Rm 12:8; Hort, Tg 1:5, and see: ἁπλῶς).†
(AS)

G0573.def:
ἁπλοῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν
(contr. fr. -όος; ἁ.- cop., πλόος), [in LXX: Pv 11:25 * ;]
simple, single: in a moral sense (DCG, ii, 628 f.), ἀφθαλμός, Mt 6:22, Lc 11:34. (In π. of a marriage dowry, see MM, see word).†
ἁπλόος, see: ἁπλοῦς
SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἀκέραιος (Tr., Syn., § lvi; Cremer, 107, 639) (AS)

G0574.def:
ἁπλῶς
adv. (ἁπλοῦς), [in LXX: Pv 10:9 (תֹּם), Wis.16:27, 2Ma.6:6 * ;]
simply, sincerely, graciously: Tg 1:5. ("Later writers comprehend under the one word the whole magnanimous and honour­able type of character in which ... singleness of mind is the central feature "-Hort, Ja., l.with)†
(AS)

G0575.def:
ἀπό (on the frequently neglect of elision bef. vowels, see Tdf., Pr., 94, WH, App., 146),
prep. with genitive (WM, 462ff.; on its relation to ἐκ, παρά, ὑπό, ib. 456f.), [in LXX for לְ ,בְּ ,מִן ;]
from (i.e. from the exterior).
__1. Of separation and cessation;
__(1) of motion from a place: Mt 5:29, 30 7:23, Lc 5:2 22:41, al.;
__(2) in partitive sense (M, Pr., 72, 102, 245; MM, see word; Bl., §40, 2), Mt 9:16 27:21, Jo 21:10, At 5:2, al.; also after verbs of eating, etc.;
__(3) of alienation (cl. genitive of separation), after such verbs as λούω (Deiss., BS, 227), λύω, σώζω, παύω, etc.; ἀνάθεμα ἀ., Rm 9:3; ἀποθνήσκειν ἀ., Cl 2:20; σαλευθῆναι, 2Ts 2:2, καθαρός, -ίζειν, ἀ. (Deiss., BS, 196, 216), At 20:26, 2Co 7:1, Hb 9:14;
__(4) of position, Mt 23:34 24:31, al.; after μακράν, Mt 8:30; transposed before measures of distance, Jo 10:18 21:8, Ap 14:20 (Abbott, JG, 227);
__(5) of time, ἀπὸ τ. ὥρας, ἡμέρας, etc., Mt 9:22, Jo 19:27, At 20:18, Fp 1:5, al.; ἀπ᾽ αἰῶνος, Lc 1:70, al.; ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς, etc., Mt 19:4, Rm 1:20; ἀπὸ βρέφους, 2Tm 3:15; ἀφ᾽ ἧς, since, Lc 7:45, al.; ἀπὸ τ. νῦν, Lc 1:48, al.; ἀπὸ τότε, Mt 4:17, al.; ἀπὸ πέρυσι, a year ago, 2Co 8:10 9:2; ἀπὸ πρωΐ, At 28:23;
__(6) of order or rank, ἀπὸ διετοῦς, Mt 2:16; ἀπὸ Ἀβραάμ, Mt 1:17; ἐβδομος ἀπὸ Ἀδάμ, Ju 14; ἀπὸ μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου, At 8:10, Hb 8:11; ἄρχεσθαι ἀπό, Mt 20:8, Jo 8:9, At 8:35, al.
__2. Of origin;
__(1) of birth, extraction, and hence, in late writers,
__(a) of local extraction (cl. ἐξ; Abbott, JG, 227ff.), Mt 21:11, Mc 15:43, Jo 1:45, At 10:38, al.; οἱ ἀπὸ Ἰταλίας (WM, §66, 6; M, Pr., 237; Westc, Rendall, in l.), Hb 13:24;
__(b) of membership in a community or society (BL, §40, 2), At 12:1, al.;
__(with) of material (= cl. genitive; Bl. l.with; M, Pr., 102), Mt 3:4 27:21;
__(d) after verbs of asking, seeking, etc., Lc 11:50, 51 1Ts 2:6 (Milligan, in l.);
__(2) of the cause, instrument, means or occasion (frequently = ὑπό, παρά, and after verbs of learning, hearing, knowing, etc.; Bl., §40, 3), Mt 7:16 11:29, Lc 22:45, At 2:22 4:36 9:13 12:14, 1Co 11:23, Gl 3:2, al.; ἀπὸ τ. ὄχλου, Lc 19:3 (cf. Jo 21:6, At 22:11); ἀπὸ τ. φόβου, Mt 14:26, al. (cf. Mt 10:26 13:44).
__3. Noteworthy Hellenistic phrases: φοβεῖσθαι ἀπό (M, Pr., 102, 107); προσέχειν ἀπό (M, Pr., 11. with; Milligan, NTD, 50); ἀπὸ νότου (Heb. מִגֶּנֶב), Ap 21:13; ἀπὸ προσώπου (מִפְּנֵי), 2Ts 1:9 (Bl., §40, 9); ἀπὸ τ. καρδιῶν (בְּלֵב), Mt 18:35; ἀπὸ ὁ ὤν (WM, §10, 2; M, Pr., 9), Ap 1:4.
__4. In composition, ἀπό denotes separation, departure, origin, etc. (ἀπολύω, ἀπέρχομαι, ἀπογράφω); it also has a perfective force (M, Pr., 112, 247), as in ἀφικνεῖσθαι, which see
(AS)

G0576.def:
ἀπο-βαίνω
[in LXX for הָיָה, etc. ;]
to step off, disembark: Lc 5:2, Jo 21:9; metaphorically, of events, to issue, turn out (Field, Notes, 74): Lc 21:13, Fp 1:19 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0577.def:
ἀπο-βάλλω
[in LXX: Is 1:30 (נָבֵל) and elsew. without Heb. equiv. ;]
to throw off: Mc 10:50; metaphorically, to lose, let go (Field, Notes, 231 f.; MM, see word): Hb 10:35.†
(AS)

G0578.def:
ἀπο-βλέπω
[in LXX for פָּנָה, etc. ;]
to look away from all else at one object; hence, to look steadfastly: Hb 11:26 (cf. ἀφοράω).†
(AS)

G0579.def:
ἀπό-βλητος, -ον
(ἀποβάλλω), [in Aq.: Lv 7:18, al.; Sm.: Os 9:3 (טָמֵא) ;]
to be thrown away, rejected: 1Tm 4:4 (Hom., Plut.).†
(AS)

G0580.def:
ἀπο-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀποβάλλω);
__1. a throwing away, rejection: opposite to πρόσλημψις, Rm 11:15.
__2. a losing, loss: At 27:22.†
(AS)

G0581.def:
ἀπο-γίνομαι (cl. -γίγν-)
[in LXX: Da TH Dn 2:1 * ;]
__1. to be away, removed from.
__2. to depart life, to die (MM, see word): τ. ἀμαρτίαις, i.e. with ref. to sins, 1Pe 2:24 (Cremer, 149, 668).†
(AS)

G0582.def:
ἀπο-γραφή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀπογράφω)
[in LXX: Dn 10:21 (כָּתָב), I Et 8:30, AB, 2Ma.2:1, 3Ma.2:32 3Mac 4:15 3Mac 4:17 3Mac 7:22 * ;]
__1. a written copy.
__2. As law term, a deposition (Demos.).
__3. In late writers, a register, enrolment, census (MM, see word; Deiss., LAE, 160, 268 f.): Lc 2:2, At 5:37.†
(AS)

G0583.def:
ἀπο-γράφω
[in LXX: Jz 8:14, Pv 22:20 (כָּתַב), I Et 8:30, 3Ma.2:29 3Mac 4:14 3Mac 6:34 3Mac 6:38 * ;]
__1. to write out, copy.
__2. to enrol; mid., to enrol oneself: Lc 2:1 (M, Pr., 162; but. see ICC, in l), Lc 2:3, 5; pass., Hb 12:23 (see reff, see word ἀπογραφή ).†
(AS)

G0584.def:
ἀπο-δείκνυμι
[in LXX: Et 2:9 (רָאָה), al. ;]
__1. to bring out, show forth, exhibit (Lft., Notes, 200; ICC, in l): 1Co 4:9.
__2. to declare, show: At 2:22
__3. to prove: At 25:7.
__4. As frequently in late Gk., to proclaim to an office: before ὅτι, 2Ts 2:4 (Milligan, in l; MM, see word; Lft., Notes. 113.)†
(AS)

G0585.def:
ἀπό-δειξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποδείκνυμι) [in LXX: 3Ma.4:20, 4Ma.3:19 4Mac 13:10 * ;]
__1. a showing off.
__2. As used by Gk. philosophers, demonstration, certain proof: 1Co 2:4 (see ICC, in l; MM, see word; Lft., Notes, 173).†
(AS)

G0586.def:
ἀπο-δεκατοω,
[in LXX for עָשַׂר in both senses foll., e.g. (1) Gn 28:22 (2) 1Rs 8:15 ;]
__1. with accusative of thing(s), to tithe, pay a tenth of: Mt 23:23, Lc 11:42.
__2. C. accusative of person(s), to exact tithes from: Hb 7:5.
__3. to decimate (Socr., HE, 573 A; see Kennedy, Sources, 117).†
(AS)

G0588.def:
ἀπο-δέχομαι
[in LXX: Tob.7:17, Jdth.13:13; Jdt.13.1, 4Mac.10:1-21 * ;]
to accept gladly, welcome, receive: Lc 8:40 9:11, At 18:27 21:17 28:30; metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), At 2:41 24:3 (MM, see word; Cremer, 688).†
(AS)

G0589.def:
ἀπο-δημέω, -ῶ
(ἀπόδημος), [in LXX: Eze.19:3 A * ;]
to be or go abroad (M, Pr., 130, 2): Mt 21:33 25:14-15, Mc 12:1, Lc 15:13 20:9.†
(AS)

G0590.def:
ἀπό-δημος, -ον
gone abroad (RV, sojourning in another country): Mc 13:34.†
(AS)

G0591.def:
ἀπο-δίδωμι
[in LXX for מָכַר, שׁוּב hi., נָתַן, שָׁלֵם pi., etc. ;]
to give up or back, restore, return: Mt 27:58, Lc 4:20 9:42 19:8; esp. of wages, debts, oaths, etc. (MM, see word), to render what is due, to pay (Deiss., LAE, 334 f.): absol., Mt 18:25, 28, Lc 7:42. with accusative, Mt 5:26 18:29-30, 34 20:8 21:41 22:21, Mc 12:17, Lc 10:35 12:59 20:25, Rm 13:7, Hb 12:11, Ap 22:2; ὅρκους, Mt 5:33 (cf. Nm 30:3, Dt 23:21 al.); of conjugal duty, τ. ὀφειλήν, 1Co 7:3; ἀμοιβάς, 1Tm 5:4; μαρτύριον, to give (as in duty bound) testimony, At 4:33; λόγον, to render account, Mt 12:36, Lc 16:2, At 19:40, Hb 13:17, 1Pe 4:5; hence of requital, recompense, both in good and bad sense, Mt 6:4, 6 6:18 16:27, Rm 2:6, 2Tm 4:8 4:14 Ap 18:6 22:12; κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ, Rm 12:17, 1Ts 5:15, 1Pe 3:9. Mid., to give up of one's own, hence to sell (fr. Hdt. on): with accusative of thing(s), At 5:8, Hb 12:16; with accusative of person(s), At 7:9 (cf. ἀνταποδίδωμι) .†
(AS)

G0592.def:
ἀπο-δι-ορίζω
(διορίζω, ἅρος, a limit),
to mark off, hence metaphorically to make separations: Ju 19 (Cremer, 806).†
(AS)

G0593.def:
ἀπο-δοκιμάζω
[in LXX: Sl 118:22, al. (מָאַס) ;]
to reject: Mt 21:42 (LXX), Mc 8:31 12:10" (LXX) Lc 9:22 17:25 20:17" (LXX), Hb 12:17, 1Pe 2:4 2:7" (LXX) (Cremer, 701; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0596.def:
ἀπο-θήκη, -ης, ἡ
(ἀποτίθημι), [in LXX for אוֹצָר, טֶנֶא, etc. ;]
a storehouse, granary: Mt 3:12 6:26 13:30, Lc 3:17 12:18, 24.†
(AS)

G0597.def:
ἀπο-θησαυρίζω
[in LXX: Sir.3:4 * ;]
to treasure up, store away: 1Tm 6:19.†
(AS)

G0598.def:
ἀπο-θλίβω
[in LXX for לָחַץ, Nm 22:25 * ;]
to press hard: Lc 8:45.†
(AS)

G0599.def:
ἀπο-θνῄσκω,
[in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;]
to die: of natural death, Mc 5:35, al.; of violent death (pass. of ἀποκτείνω), esp. of Christ, Mt 26:35, Jo 12:33, Hb 10:28, al.; of spiritual death, Jo 6:50, Rm 8:13, al.; with dative ref., Rm 6:2, 10 14:7, 8, Gl 2:19; accusative, ὅ, Rm 6:10; before ἐν, Mt 8:32, Jo 8:21, 24 1Co 15:22, Hb 11:37, Ap 14:13; before ὑπέρ, περί, Jo 11:50, 51 18:14, Rm 5:6-8 14:15, 1Co 15:3, 2Co 5:15, 1Ts 5:10, 1Pe 3:18; ἀπό, Cl 2:20; ἐκ, Ap 8:11; figuratively, 1Co 15:31 (cf. συν-αποθνήσκω, and V. Milligan, NTD, 258f.; DCG, i, 791b; Cremer, 286; MM, see word; on the perfective force of this verb, M, Pr., 112, 114; and on the distinction bet. present and aor., ib. 113 f.).
(AS)
